title: Earl Norem
description: "Gary (Gerani, Editor of STAR WARS GALAXY) told me he read somewhere that George Lucas alwavs wanted to see the Wookiees on their native planet, doing some kind of tribal war dance around a bonfire," recalls Earl Norem. "Gary thought l'd be perfect for the assighment. I hope George approves!" Norem, the gentleman's gentleman of fantasy illustration, has worked for companies as diverse as Marvel Comics and Reader's Digest. His masterful paintings for SAVAGE SWORD OF CONAN, RAMPAGING HULK and DINOSAURS ATTACK! are among the most respected in the field.
